question: Does fixed local torque reconstruction coupling change competent receding-horizon teacher behavior and improve a standalone fixed student after matched fitting, then support a second useful acquisition-learning round?

inputs.checkpoint_hash_contract: File SHA256 is distinct from actor tensor and optimizer fingerprints; validate each separately.
inputs.global_envelope: Copy the exact already-declared P1 stream0 envelope; it is not the missing historical W2 global RNG.
inputs.outer_launch_manifest: Bind create-only copied inputs, all source bytes, runtime/native binary/XML receipt, config hash, prepared forks and ledger before any native work; no mutable path substitution.

controller.alpha_large_origin: Historical A/B/C calibration 0.5 std(C)/std(D), held fixed; no recalibration or weight search.
controller.initialization: Zero float64 (48,6) plan at each restored restart; no policy/teacher centering.
controller.refinement: Existing MPPI.plan_step: two passes before first physical action, one thereafter; no extra refinement or horizon annealing.
controller.shift: After each decision exactly once, use existing last-control replication; retain carried plan and private planner PCG within episode.
controller.candidate_cost: Unchanged Walker rollout_cost: native running costs through first fall, terminal20 once, absorbing5 per missing horizon control.
controller.candidate_d: Use pre-action state; include fall-causing action and exclude post-fall or invalid observations. No inference on post-fall suffixes.
controller.invalid_candidates: Invalid executable prefix has infinite task/objective cost; a physical fall alone is not numerical invalidity or a controller abort.
controller.population_d_in_alpha0: Measure D diagnostically under the same calling convention but multiply by zero in weights; no policy-conditioned score or fallback in independent arm.
controller.policy_execution: Unchanged bounded Torch Policy.predict and native clipped17 observations for scoring, fitting and direct execution. Promote returned actions to float64 before env.step; do not deploy P1 NumPy actor.
controller.roster_completion: Execute all24 round1 episodes despite candidate/teacher falls, then all48 round2 episodes if that round is authorized. Native done ends only its own episode.
controller.physical_trace: Save actual N+1 states, warmstarts, integration arrays, observations and N actions/costs; no fabricated post-fall rows.
controller.sampling_scope: Standard local MPPI sampling/noise/temperature exactly as walker2d_best; no FullPI zero-noise sample override or ESS-target addition.

native_verification.episode_roster: Replay first-restart episode for each of3 R1 alpha arms, and each of6 fork/arm R2 controllers if reached; max9 episodes/2700 native controls.
native_verification.candidate_roster: At each of72 reached teacher episodes, independently replay candidate0 and255 from control0/pass0, through first fall or48 controls; max144 prefixes/6912 native controls.

tolerance.D_atol_formula: accumulation_atol + 2*(6*L)*action_atol, where L is actual executable replay-prefix length

native_verification.evidence: Save complete rawH5 native replay states/warmstart/integration/actions/costs, stored reference arrays, actor predictions, C/D and comparisons. This is paid worker verification, not zero-physics independent audit.
native_verification.failure: Replay mismatch is numerical/implementation failure: preserve paid work, stop without relaxation or source replacement.
native_verification.torch_grouping: Native prefix Torch calls use L<=48 rows; a source bank may use up to12288. Require every corresponding action prediction component to differ by at most1e-6 and retain actual prediction/error arrays. For controls and predictions bounded by1, each half-squared residual changes by at most2*action_atol, so sourceD/nativeD tolerance is1e-10+2*(6L)*1e-6. This is explicit numerical propagation, not assumed identical call grouping. State/warmstart/integration1e-10 and C1e-9 remain unchanged; source full-bank independent D uses same grouping and tolerance1e-6. Historical P1 contracts unchanged.
native_verification.context_scope: Native episode replay compares saved states/warmstarts/integration/observations/actions/costs. Candidate replay compares full initial context plus forecast poststates/C/D; post-warmstart/integration are retained in native replay H5 but cannot be compared with unavailable forecast counterparts.

controller.independent_score: J=C exactly; never compute 0*infinite or0*missingD. Diagnostic D cannot modify alpha0 weights.

selection.timing: After all24 controller episodes and before any fitting or fitted outcome is read.
selection.local_walking: Exactly300 executed controls, no native fall, and mean absolute target-velocity error<=.3m/s.
selection.full_survival: Exactly300 executed controls and no native fall; longer survival alone is not local walking.
selection.effect: Pooled RMS over all common executed (restart,control,action-dimension) differences versus alpha0 >=.01; every restart contributes at least one common control.
selection.competence: Positive local-walking and full-survival counts must not be below independent; mean complete cost<=1.10 independent.
selection.local_velocity: Report mean of eight per-episode observed-prefix MAEs, pooled observed MAE and executed controls; no fabricated missing-tail velocity.
selection.tie_rule: Choose weak if it qualifies, otherwise large if it qualifies. No task-cost tie optimization, MSE, spectra or fitted results select the arm.
selection.failure: If neither qualifies, close after all24 controllers; preserve every failed prefix and all cost, no fit or weight retry.

learning.normalization: Exact inherited float32 mean/std buffers; no recomputation, unclipping or feature change.
learning.targets: Actual executed teacher torques, float32 in existing fitter; no filtering, relabeling or weighting.
learning.corpus: All common executed prefixes joined by (restart_id,control_index), restart then control order, each of8 contributes>=1; equal arm N<=2400; new-round-only corpus, no historical/evaluation/held rows appended.
learning.optimizer: Exact incoming Adam state including moments and counters; existing Adam lr3e-4, foreach=False/fused=False; no parent refits.
learning.fork_rng: Clone incoming private PCG64; jumped(fork+1) once at R1 preparation. Hash each fork then copy actor/normalization/Adam/private Torch/global RNG to its independent and coupled arms.
learning.paired_indices: Within a round/contrast, same N and same inherited PCG state imply identical sampled row-index streams; save every draw/state transition.
learning.round2_rng: No second jump or reseed; load each retained R1 child with exact Adam/private PCG/private Torch/global continuation.
learning.resume_fit_meaning: Begin a new corpus block while preserving Adam/private PCG/cumulative counters; eta0 makes anchor refresh irrelevant but provenance remains explicit.
learning.checkpoints: Save and reload actual complete incoming/outgoing checkpoints and stream files; compare actor, normalization, Adam, RNG and operative cursor; R1 cumulative4000/R2 cumulative6000.
learning.continuation_proof: Reuse the already-executed student-component unit fixture: A2→A2 and B2→B2, two exact paired2+2 continuations, eight total Adam updates/2048 backward rows. Bind its source/test receipt. Verify actual R1final→R2initial Adam/privatePCG/privateTorch/global equality and paired sampled indices. This is not a separate2+2-versus4 equivalence test and no second formal fixture is authorized.

evaluation.walking: Exactly1000 controls with no native fall and observed-post-action velocity MAE<=.3m/s.
evaluation.controller: Direct bounded Torch torque actor only; no MPPI/fallback/prefix assistance.
evaluation.confirmation: Run both panels for every fitted round even if primary benefit or teacher competence fails; only confirmed R1 permits R2.
evaluation.round1_actors: Six children plus one identical shared incoming parent;224 episodes.
evaluation.round2_actors: Six children plus all six incoming R1 actors on the fresh R2 panels;384 episodes. No duplicate shared-original-parent evaluation.
evaluation.reset_pairing: Within a panel use identical complete reset contexts across every actor/fork, bind actual integration contexts, preserve all failures.
evaluation.complete_cost: Sum native costs including fall terminal20 once, then5 per missing control. Raw physical cost and absorbing tail reported separately.

round2.enabled_only_after: Confirmed R1 walking criterion and passing provenance/accounting audit.
round2.contexts: Same8 complete source contexts and planner seeds as R1; each arm uses its own actual R1 child.
round2.alpha: Freeze the R1 selected positive alpha; independent remains0, no reselect or schedule.
round2.teacher_failure: Deterioration is retained and reported; do not proxy-abort remaining48 controllers or six fixed fits if every paired restart has positive common rows. It prevents the useful-feedback verdict.
round2.new_labels: Rebuild new-round-only equal common-prefix corpus separately for each fork.
round2.independent_repeat: Same contexts/seeds and policy-free score imply repeated independent acquisition is expected; execute/preserve actual evidence and charge it, do not invent new independent task replications.

round1.definition: Coupled walking >= independent+2 and parent+2 in the same>=2forks on both panels; no walking/full-survival regression against either comparator in any fork.

round2.definition: In the same>=2forks on both panels: (coupled child-coupled incoming parent)-(independent child-independent incoming parent)>=2, coupled child-coupled incoming parent>=2, coupled child-independent child>=2 walking; no coupled walking/full-survival regression against its own incoming parent or independent child in any fork.

round2_teacher.definition: For each fork, compare actual R2 positive teacher with R1 same-alpha teacher and R2 independent: no local-walk/full-survival-count decrease and mean complete cost<=1.10 each. Pooled actual actionRMS R2positive vsR1samealpha>=.01, all8 common prefixes positive.

criteria.useful_feedback: Confirmed R2 standalone walking benefit AND passing R2 teacher criteria in the same>=2forks; teacher nonregression against both comparators in every fork. Actual updated-actor hash must participate in R2 scoring.
criteria.individual_competence: At least15/16 full walking on BOTH panels; distinct from finite gain.
criteria.retention: More controls or survival without walking is a retention improvement, not competent walking or useful feedback.
criteria.reconstruction: Own/cross/held errors and gap changes are diagnostic, never admission or success criteria.
criteria.ceiling: An incoming parent already>=15/16 may make the two-additional-success criterion unattainable; preserve that ceiling result without relaxing the frozen gate.

seeds.planner_formula: planner_base+restart_id; deliberately reuse the original A/B/C private planner streams, paired across alpha and unchanged in R2; no new calibration.
seeds.global: No new global seed; copy already-bound P1 stream0 global envelope. Restore paired copy per contrast; preserve exact own-arm continuation thereafter.
seeds.fit_seed_argument: Ignored when incoming private PCG is loaded; do not silently reseed.
seeds.collisions: Prelaunch scan saved ledgers/configs; stop on accidental evaluation/reset-role collisions. Deliberate within-study planner pairing and inherited-data reuse are explicit.
seeds.synthetic_continuation_status: Unused reserved seed; do not launch a new fixture. Reused test_local_coupling_learning.py fixture used Policy seed1701 and initial private-PCG seed1901.

execution_audit_report_guard.scope: Portable live process-tree CPU/RSS guard plus phase RLIMIT/deadlines; total21600CPU/18000activewall includes worker,audits,report/publication; add conservative prep1800 once to reach23400CPU/19800globalactivewall. Enforce4GiB live aggregate RSS and8GiB total output.

preparation.scope: All source/testing/input work, including the already-paid eight-update paired-continuation unit fixture (2048 backward rows), native prerequisite validation and failed paid attempts. Reuse the fixture proof; do not run a second formal eight-update fixture.

synthetic_audit_parity.scope: Tiny synthetic Torch audit parity only; record actual counts before source freeze. No W2 fitting, dynamics, teacher queries or second eight-update continuation fixture.

audit.scope: Includes saved-only independent audits, report/rendering and publication. Reserve300CPU/300wall seconds for report/publication before launching audit phases; no new physics/fitting/evaluations.
audit.final_remaining: Final audit CPU/wall allowance =3300 minus actual admitted-R1 audit CPU/wall respectively; neural rows =8000000 minus actual R1 completed rows. No second full allocation; report/publication reserve300 remains separate within3600 total.

measured_cost_basis.limitation: One historical early-falling calibration bank; not a benchmark of full healthy controller trajectories. Worker18,000CPU reservation includes about1.6x bank extrapolation and all fitting/evaluation/IO; hard stop retains partial if insufficient. No new benchmark launched.

budgets.charging: Reserve before actual calls; requested/completed/unknown-partial separate. Count all physics, forward/backward rows, updates, failed attempts, constructors, IO/read bytes, transfer and engineering. Stage CPU/wall reservations sum to global; unused allowances are not equal spent compute. No new roster under remaining allowance.
budgets.historical: Prior six-round, R0/P1.1 and A/B/C costs remain separate inherited evidence; do not charge their reuse as new physics or hide them from amortized accounting.

prerequisites.definition: After source/config freeze: one four-control capture plus four-control native replay and one K1H4 forecast (8native/4model/48substeps). Reuse already-executed component fixture A2→A2 and B2→B2 (two exact paired2+2 continuations,8totalAdam/2048backward); no separate2+2vs4 claim or new formal fit fixture. Include all counts once in global caps.

save: all24 R1 controller outcomes, including unused positive arm
all48 R2 controller outcomes if launched
incoming/outgoing actual checkpoints and stream seals
both evaluation panels and failure tails
candidate/teacher pre-action actor predictions and C/D components
evidence.audit: Independently recompute all physical outcomes/cost decomposition, row joins, alpha selection, provenance, continuation, criteria and work totals. Rebuild all saved PI updates from RNG/U/weights without physics; recompute C/D/J on preserved full banks and clearly state sparse physical-state coverage. Audit is saved-only, no new fitting/evaluations/MPPI/native physics.
evidence.publication: Compact tracked capsule and checksums; large arrays/checkpoints/rawledgers remain external. Publish all negatives and exact limitations.

stopping.before_launch: Stop on missing/changed inputs, runtime/source/schema mismatch, failed full-context/pre-action/score/continuation/budget tests or unavailable reserved resources. Freeze config/source before native work.
stopping.during_roster: Native falls and low candidate survival end only that physical episode; continue all remaining predefined controllers. Stop whole study on numerical/software/provenance failure or hard budget exhaustion; retain paid partial evidence.
stopping.after_round1: Neither teacher eligible=>no fits. Failed/negative/ambiguous/unconfirmed R1 walking=>no R2. Do not tune weights, replace starts, extend updates or alter architecture.
stopping.after_round2: Stop after fixed acquisition/fits/panels/audit regardless outcome; no automatic third round, fair-compute baseline suite or follow-up.

interpretation.pre_update: The score is a declared local torque reconstruction objective available before the update. Smaller disagreement is not a validated teachability score; usefulness is judged by subsequent walking.
interpretation.h4_1: H4.1 changed a backoff weight in a separate candidate-reweighting teacher and regressing guided lineage with appended history/proximity settings; it already supplied an updated-actor negative result. L2 uses direct carried-plan H48 MPPI, three fixed-alpha controller arms, W2s0 eta0 learner, all-prefix new-round-only corpora and matched jumpedPCG forks. Do not call H4.1 a non-coupling experiment.
interpretation.coverage: Eight source contexts belong to one old student episode; forks are optimizer-stream replications, not independent policy initializations or8independent task seeds.
interpretation.feedback: Two useful rounds support finite feedback-associated learning only; no frozen-old-actor R2 control isolates causal benefit of actorfeedback over further fitting.
interpretation.scope: No architecture/noise-target/critic/environment/transport/filter intervention; no equal-compute plain-cloning/low-pass-cloning/DAgger or second-body comparison; no full project success or asymptotic convergence claim.
interpretation.historical_continuation_tests: Existing P1 split-versus-whole tests remain historical separate evidence unchanged; do not represent them as a new L2 execution.
